meta.description: Canonical geography for the HDX DOH-Epi dengue dataset (2016–2021): 126 reporting units, the 81 provinces and 17 regions they aggregate to, and representative points. Geography only — no case values.

observationSource.source: HDX — Philippine Dengue Cases and Deaths (Cirrolytix; DOH-EB data)

rules: Reporting units are mutually exclusive and together cover all 1,642 COD-AB admin-3 units (checked).
A province_remainder unit is NOT the whole province; aggregate with its excluded cities to obtain the province.
Sum only upward (unit → province → region → national) and only for weeks where every member unit reported.
Never split a unit, province, region or national value into smaller areas.
centroid is a representative point inside the unit for markers, not a boundary and not a location of cases.

psgcCode is the current PSA PSGC 3Q 2026 code, checked per unit; psgcCodes lists every code. psgcCode is null for province remainders (not a PSGC area) and for 2016–2021 provinces that are now several PSGC areas. Current codes follow today's regions (Negros Island Region, Sulu in Region IX): aggregate by analysisRegionId, never by code prefix.
